uncited: - Bits 16–23: Leaf mask (indicates if children are leaf nodes).
Identify the target child voxel index $i$ ($i \in [0, 7]$).
Determine the bit position for the valid mask: $b_{\text{valid}} = i$.
Determine the bit position for the leaf mask: $b_{\text{leaf}} = 16 + i$.
Where $\text{mask}$ is the 32-bit integer, $i$ is the child index ($0 \le i \le 7$), and $\lfloor \cdot \rfloor$ denotes integer division.
- If the valid mask is 0, no children exist.
- Bitwise operations are exact; no floating-point precision issues occur.
- Time Complexity: Not given in the sources.
It is based on the implicit octree storage model where node metadata is packed into integers.
